environment.note: Every direct HTTP request issued from this sandbox returned connection failure (HTTP 000) for olbg.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, atptour.com, wtatennis.com and ultimatetennisstatistics.com. Pages below were retrieved through the hosted page-fetch tool, which does have egress. Consequence: the collectors in scripts/ are written and parser-tested against saved fixtures, but their live network behaviour must be confirmed by a GitHub Actions run.

irregularities.title: OLBG exposes no structured odds
irregularities.detail: The tips index and event pages are server-rendered, but prices are injected client-side into the betslip. The only price text observed was inside free-text tipster commentary on event 899350 ('Alcaraz is favored at 1.20, Safiullin 5.50'). Step 1 of the prompt requires odds cross-referenced across at least two bookmakers; that requirement cannot be met from OLBG. An odds aggregator is required and none is reachable without an API key.
irregularities.impact: Odds-dependent scoring factors (implied-probability band, first-set price band, handicap price band, both -500 blocks) are unscoreable. The engine records them as missing rather than estimating.

irregularities.title: The standard free ATP/WTA match datasets are no longer publicly reachable
irregularities.detail: github.com/JeffSackmann/tennis_atp returns 404 over both the HTML and raw.githubusercontent.com paths. A GitHub API call to /users/JeffSackmann/repos returned exactly one public repository: tennis_MatchChartingProject (point-by-point charting, not full match results). Numerous third-party READMEs still link the tennis_atp CSVs, so those links are now stale.
irregularities.impact: Blocks the historical backtest corpus and the form/surface/serve factors. Forward collection is unaffected.

irregularities.title: Collection cannot run from the development sandbox
irregularities.detail: No outbound network in the sandbox, so scripts/collect_olbg.py and scripts/collect_players.py cannot be executed here. The seed snapshot in data/slate.json was retrieved through the hosted page-fetch tool and transcribed field by field from that response.
irregularities.impact: Parser logic is unit-tested against saved fixtures; live fetch behaviour is unverified until run in CI.

irregularities.title: Tournament, tour, round and surface are absent from the OLBG tips index
irregularities.detail: The index lists only player names, kickoff and consensus. The tournament stage and surface factors in Step 2 depend on data OLBG does not publish here. The presence of 'US Open' and 'US Open Women' outright markets on the same page suggests the event, but that is an inference, not a source, so the fields are left null.
irregularities.impact: Tournament stage (10 pts) and surface form (20 pts) are unscoreable until enriched from ATP/WTA.

irregularities.title: The tips index only lists matches that already have tipster coverage
irregularities.detail: The page paginates with 'Load More Tips' and is ordered by tip volume; matches with zero tips appear only on the All Events index.
irregularities.impact: data/slate.json is not the complete slate. The collector targets both indexes.

irregularities.title: Two matches have consensus only on an excluded market
irregularities.detail: Events 899314 (Grabher v Cirstea) and 899395 (Mensik v Mochizuki) list Total Games as their consensus market. The prompt excludes set betting and total games entirely, so no win-match consensus is available for them from the index.
irregularities.impact: Those two matches have no consensus signal for the scored markets.

irregularities.title: Two Step 4 output rules conflict as literally written
irregularities.detail: 'The predicted winner must be bolded and obvious within the first 20 words' combined with 'no two tips may open with the same word' cannot both hold if the bolded name is the first word: all three markets for one match would then open identically. Resolved by leading with a distinctive analytical opener and placing the bolded pick inside the 20-word window; the validator enforces both simultaneously.
irregularities.impact: Tip layout differs from a naive reading of the prompt.

irregularities.title: The unique-opening rule is not satisfiable for large cards
irregularities.detail: Three markets per match means a 20-match card needs 60 tips. There are 24 distinct hand-written openings. Beyond that the rule cannot be honoured without fabricating filler.
irregularities.impact: writeCard reports openerPoolExhausted and the UI shows a warning instead of silently repeating openings.

irregularities.title: Cached search results disagree with the live page
irregularities.detail: A search-engine cache of the OLBG tennis page listed 'Iga Swiatek v Elena Rybakina' and 'Coco Gauff v Marta Kostyuk' as upcoming, while the live fetch on 2026-08-31 shows Swiatek v Xiyu Wang and Sonmez v Gauff. The cached copy is stale.
irregularities.impact: Only the live fetch was used. Any future collector must not treat cached copies as authoritative.

irregularities.title: Kickoff times carry no explicit timezone on the page
irregularities.detail: OLBG renders UK local time but does not state it per row. Rows reading 'Today'/'Tomorrow' were resolved against the 00:12 UTC fetch time; the literal '01 Sept' rows on the same page are consistent with that resolution, which cross-checks it.
irregularities.impact: Rows carry date_basis: 'observed' or 'derived' so the distinction is visible in the data.

irregularities.title: Defects in the prompt's scoring rules
irregularities.detail: See docs/PROMPT_REVIEW.md. In summary: the first-set market inherits the win-match base so its floor sits above its own HIGH threshold; surface form is scored on raw win count with no denominator; the ranking bands omit top-20-vs-top-20 and both-inside-top-50; bonuses can push a 100-point scale past 100; and the odds band is labelled 'value' while measuring implied probability.
irregularities.impact: Each defect is patched behind a named flag in engine/engine.mjs and covered by a test.

irregularities.title: The WTA/ATP handicap equivalence is unsourced
irregularities.detail: The prompt states a WTA -3.5 is roughly equivalent to an ATP -5.5. No source is given and nothing reachable here supports or refutes it. The prompt also asserts set betting and total games have 'documented negative expected value' with no citation, while excluding those markets and simultaneously recommending games handicap, which is the same market family.
irregularities.impact: Treated as an assumption, not a fact. The engine does not apply a gender handicap adjustment; it would need the backtest corpus to calibrate.

irregularities.title: Two Step 1 requirements are not achievable from free public sources
irregularities.detail: Social-media and analyst sentiment from X requires paid API access or ToS-restricted scraping. Structured injury reporting has no free API. Both are excluded rather than approximated.
irregularities.impact: Sentiment is dropped entirely; physical concerns are scored only when a citable source exists.
